Apple is expected to launch a brand new Home lineup in October, and thanks to leaked images discovered today by MacRumors contributor Aaron Perris, we got our first look at the upcoming products.

HomePod mini New Colors Spotted in Leaked Images, Fourth-Generation Apple TV 4K Retains Current Design

According to MacRumors, Aaron Perris discovered evidence of three new products today that could be unveiled in October, including a new HomePod mini, Apple TV 4K, and iPad mini.

Perris found new images of the HomePod mini in Apple's code, offering five color options. Three of these — green, pink, and blue — are brand new colors, alongside the existing white and black.

The new color options can be seen in the article below:

Additionally, Perris found an image of the fourth-generation Apple TV 4K. As seen in the article below, the new device appears to retain the design of the current model:

No further details about the new products were obtained from Apple's code. But these findings further corroborate rumors that Apple plans to unveil new products in October.
